title: Fedora split-package — failure / residual-risk matrix
summary: No structural failures. The split-spec test (packaging/tests/test_fedora_split.sh) reports 96/96 assertions passing. The residual risks below are environmental or human-gated, not defects in the spec.

residual_risks.rpmbuild_mock_not_installed: rpmbuild, mock, and rpmlint are not available on this Arch host, so a real RPM compile/lint was not executed. The spec is verified structurally (96 assertions). A Fedora host with mock is required to confirm compilation, RPM lint, and the three-subpackage RPM payload. The build steps are unchanged from the previously-shipped monolithic spec that did compile.
residual_risks.real_mock_three_subpackages: mock/rpmbuild producing exactly three binary RPMs (namtor, namtor-gnome, namtor-kde) from the one spec is asserted structurally (%package gnome, %package kde, bare %files + %files gnome + %files kde) but not exercised end-to-end without rpmbuild.
residual_risks.rpm_lint_clean: rpmlint cleanliness (no duplicate-file, no dir-or-file-in-%files, no missing-requires) is not machine-verified here. The %files partitioning is disjoint by construction (core excludes the GNOME/KDE files the test enumerates), and each subpackage carries its own %license COPYING.md, but rpmlint may flag subtleties only visible after a real build.
residual_risks.desktop_cache_scriptlets_untested: The %post/%postun gnome and %post/%postun kde scriptlets call update-desktop-database and gtk-update-icon-cache with `|| :` (best-effort). These are standard Fedora practice but are not exercised in CI (no running desktop).
residual_risks.qt6_kf6_runtime_deps_best_effort: The KDE subpackage Requires qt6-qtbase, kf6-kirigami, kf6-kcoreaddons explicitly. The actual shared-library deps of libnamtorqml.so are resolved by rpmbuild's automatic Requires scanning at build time; the explicit Requires are a lower bound so the package is installable without auto-deps. A real build may add more auto-Requires.
residual_risks.pam_install_test_pre_existing: packaging/tests/test_pam_install.sh fails on the dirty working tree (a prior task rewrote packaging/pam-install.sh into a thin wrapper around the Rust namtor-pam-edit binary; that test still targets the old shell block-insertion behaviour). Confirmed pre-existing: the test fails identically when packaging/fedora/namtor.spec is reverted to the monolithic version. Out of scope for Task 21 (MUST NOT modify the shared pam-install.sh).

must_not_do_violations: none — only packaging/fedora/namtor.spec was modified among packaging files. No changes to packaging/arch/*, packaging/debian/*, packaging/lifecycle.sh, packaging/install-manifest.toml, packaging/stage.sh, or any Rust source.
